children: Ciena reported fiscal third-quarter 2026 revenue of $1.67 billion, up 37% year-over-year, and GAAP diluted net income per share of $1.83. Adjusted (non-GAAP) diluted EPS was $2.11 for the quarter. The company raised its fiscal 2026 revenue guidance to $6.42 billion (±$50 million) and provided Q4 revenue guidance of $1.75 billion (±$50 million).
Revenue: $1,671.1 million for fiscal Q3 2026, up 37.0% year-over-year (Q3 2025: $1,219.4 million).
Gross profit: GAAP gross profit $759.3 million; GAAP gross margin 45.4%. Adjusted (non-GAAP) gross margin 46.4%.
Operating income: GAAP income from operations $301.2 million (18.0% operating margin); adjusted (non-GAAP) income from operations $375.7 million (22.5% operating margin).
Net income: GAAP net income $266.4 million for the quarter; GAAP diluted net income per share $1.83.
Adjusted (non-GAAP) diluted earnings per share: $2.11 for fiscal Q3 2026 (compared with $0.67 adjusted in Q3 2025).
Segment mix: Networking platforms represented the majority of revenue (Total Networking Platforms $1,355.7 million; Optical Networking $1,191.3 million and Routing & Switching $164.4 million).
Services and software: Platform Software and Services totaled $98.6 million; Global Services (maintenance, implementation, advisory) totaled $193.6 million.

Customer concentration and working capital: Two customers represented over 10% of revenue each, together accounting for 41.7% of revenue; average days' sales outstanding were 76 and inventory turns were 3.5.

Capital deployment and balance sheet actions: Repurchased ~0.4 million shares for $171.7 million under the $1 billion repurchase program; cash and cash equivalents totaled $2,445.7 million as of August 1, 2026.
Operational capacity and supply: Management cited expanding supply capacity and strengthening operating leverage as drivers of more profitable growth and positioning for AI-driven network demand.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: Ciena posts Q3 FY2026 revenue $1.67B, adjusted diluted EPS $2.11; raises FY26 revenue guide
